{{Top}} {{Otheruses}} {{Character |type=Galactic Republic |image=[[File:Jek-Ambush.png]] |option1=22 BBY |image2=[[File:UnidentifiedSwampTrooper-ROTS.png]] |option2=19 BBY |name=Jek |homeworld=[[Kamino]]''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Character Encyclopedia - Join the Battle!]]'' |birth= |death=[[19 BBY]], [[Kashyyyk]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' |species=[[Human]] {{C|[[Cloning|clone]]}}{{TCW|Ambush}} |gender=[[Gender|Male]] |pronouns=He/Him |donor=[[Jango Fett]] |height=1.83 [[meter]]s {{C|6[[Foot|ft]]}} |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Tan |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Republic]] **[[Diplomatic service]] **[[41st Elite Corps]] ***[[Ranger Corps]]''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'' |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|Okay clankers, suck laser!|Jek, to battle droids on Rugosa|audio=JekSuckLaser.flac|}} '''Jek''' was a [[Imperial shock trooper|clone shock trooper]] who served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. In [[22 BBY]], he served alongside [[Jedi Master]] [[Yoda]] on [[Rugosa]] as part of a [[Yoda's squad (Rugosa)|small squad]] and, later, served at the [[Battle of Kashyyyk]] under Yoda once again in [[19 BBY]]. At [[Kashyyyk]], Jek was a [[Clone Captain]] within the [[Ranger Corps]] and was present when [[Order 66]] was issued; despite his previous camaraderie with Yoda, Jek nevertheless attempted to execute the order alongside Commander [[Gree (clone trooper)|Gree]]. Yoda sensed a [[Disturbance in the Force|disturbance]] in [[the Force]], however, and decapitated both clones before they could carry out the order. ==Biography== ===Early life=== [[File:Rugosa_Republic_Squad.png|thumb|left|250px|Jek traveled to Rugosa with Master Yoda, Lieutenant Thire, and Rys on a diplomatic mission.]] [[Reproduction|Grown]] on the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] from the [[DNA]] of [[Jango Fett]], a [[bounty hunter]] who became the [[Clone template|template]] of the [[clone trooper]] [[army]] and trained in combat, the [[Cloning|clone]] that assumed the name Jek was created for the pan-[[The galaxy|galactic]] [[Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]], serving as a [[Imperial shock trooper|clone shock trooper]] in the Republic's [[Coruscant Guard]] [[diplomatic service]].{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/ambush-concept-art-gallery|text="Ambush" Concept Art Gallery}} ===Ambush on Rugosa=== ====Surprised in space==== In the [[Standard year|year]] [[22 BBY]],{{TCWcanondates|101}} As the Ambush on Rugosa occurred in "Ambush," the battle must have occurred in 22 BBY. concurrent with the [[Battle of Ryloth]] Jek was one of three of the Guard's service that joined [[Jedi]] [[Grand Master]] and [[Jedi General]] [[Yoda]] on a diplomatic [[Battle of Rugosa|mission]] to the [[coral]] [[moon]] [[Rugosa]] to meet with [[King]] [[Katuunko]] of [[Toydaria]] where the Republic sought to construct a supply base following Toydaria's secret sponsorship of a Republic supply mission to [[Ryloth]] during the fierce [[Battle of Ryloth|campaign]] there.{{TCW|Supply Lines}} Jek's fellow clones in the small [[Yoda's squad (Rugosa)|squad]][[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Official Collector's Edition|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' – The Official Collector's Edition]] included [[Rys]] and their superior, [[Clone Lieutenant]] [[Thire]]. The Republic envoy arrived above the moon aboard a [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)|''Consular''-class cruiser]] [[Commanding officer|commanded]] by [[Clone Captain]] [[Zak]] and were scheduled to secretly meet atop a [[Rugosan King coral]] with the [[Toydarian]] king.''[[Star Wars: The Visual Encyclopedia]]'' When the Republic arrived, Jek was on the [[cruiser]]'s [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] along with the others when they discovered that their communications were being [[Jammer|jammed]]. They were soon attacked by two Separatsit [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] that arrived from [[hyperspace]]. With the small Republic cruiser outmatched, [[Captain]] Zak stated that he needed to bring the envoy to safety, though Yoda soon belayed that and ordered that the ship should retreat while he and his escort would go down to the moon to continue their mission. The group, including Jek, boarded one of several [[Republic escape pod]]s as Zak launched all of them per Yoda's orders. While Rys [[pilot]]ed the [[escape pod]], Jek sat behind the [[Jedi Master]] as the [[frigate]]s fired on the pods. After both Rys and [[Lieutenant]] Thire confirmed that they were out of range, Yoda agreed but commented that he believed they were entering another trap. Jek looked upon Thire in confusion, before turning to Yoda and asking if he was sure. Yoda replied that he sensed a [[disturbance in the Force]], and the pod proceeded to crash land on Rugosa's surface. ====Arrival on the coral moon==== {{Quote|There's gotta be a full battalion in there. Probably packing armor, too.''"
"''We'll have something for 'em|Rys and Jek after the former views a Separatist landing ship|}} [[File:Jek-TCWCEJtB.png|thumb|right|250px|Jek preparing to fire an RPS-6 rocket launcher]] [[Sith assassin]] and Separatist [[commander]] [[Asajj Ventress]], who had surprised King Katuunko and attempted to convince him to join the Separatists. After the pod landed, Thire contacted the king so that Yoda may speak while Jek and Rys gathered their weapons. They discovered that Ventress had already reached the king with an offer of alliance with the Separatists, offered directly by Separatist [[Head of State]] [[Count of Serenno|Count]] [[Dooku]]. When Jek and Rys heard about this, they exchanged a glance.{{StoryCite|story=Sharing the Same Face|book=The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark}} The three factions agreed that if Yoda and his escorts could evade capture by Ventress's forces and reach Katuunko on the coral, Toydaria would join the Republic—otherwise, Ventress asked that the Toydarians consider an alliance with the Separatists. Following the agreement, Rys viewed a [[C-9979 landing craft]] with Ventress's forces and believing that their may be a full [[droid]] [[battalion]] there, along with [[Tank|armored]] forces. Jek picked up his [[Jek's rotary blaster cannon|rotary blaster cannon]] and commented that they'd have something for them. Yoda ordered the trio of clones to only carry what they needed to avoid slowing down, and led them in an indirect route despite Thire's initial objection to avoid the Separatist forces. After some [[time]], Yoda and his clones were spotted in what the [[battle droid]] forces designated [[Sector 11 (Rugosa)|Sector 11]], and were attacked by [[Armored Assault Tank Mk I]]s. Although Thire, Jek, and Rys were unsettled and ready for combat, Yoda assured them that they were not in range and to be at ease. The tanks could not travel further, and one of them was wedged on a coral and unable to move. Thire confirmed the situation, and Yoda expressed that size was not everything, and although they were smaller in number, they were larger in mind. When Yoda left, Jek expressed confusion to his comrades on the [[general]]'s remarks. Jek and the clones engaged droid [[infantry]] forces and became separated from the Jedi. They eventually regrouped and succeeded in eliminating the final Separatist forces before meeting Katuunko. ===Later service=== [[File:UnidentifiedSwampTrooper-ROTS.png|thumb|left|200px|Clone Captain Jek shortly before attempting to assassinate Jedi Master Yoda]] Following the battle on Rugosa, Jek followed Master Yoda's advice and retrained as a [[clone scout trooper]], eventually rising to the [[military rank]] of [[Clone Captain]] and serving in the [[Ranger Corps]] by the [[time]] of the [[Outer Rim Sieges]]. Concurrent to the sieges and after the [[Battle of Coruscant]] in [[19 BBY]], the Separatist Alliance launched an invasion of the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[Wookiee]] world of [[Kashyyyk]] due to its strategic position near the [[Foundry of the Confederacy]], where the Republic's [[12th Sector Army]] had launched multiple engagements. Jedi Grand Master Yoda volunteered to aid in the defense of Kashyyyk, accompanying the [[41st Elite Corps]] of Jedi [[General]] [[Luminara Unduli]] and [[Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)|Gree]]. Clone Captain Jek was among these forces dispatched to Kashyyyk, which landed on the [[planet]] via a ''Venator''-class Star Destroyer{{Film|III}} after [[Yoda's Republic taskforce|Yoda's task force]] smashed through the Separatist fleet, with Jek serving under Gree. [[Kachirho Wookiee Militia]] and Republic forces set up defenses on the beach, with General Yoda observing the Separatist attack from the command post above the beach in [[Kachirho]] [[City]] and assisted by Commander Gree, Captain Jek, Wookiee [[Chief]]tain General [[Tarfful]] and his [[lieutenant]] [[Chewbacca]]. Jedi Generals Unduli and [[Quinlan Vos]] participated in the battle directly as the Separatists engaged, during which [[Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Sidious]], publicly the Republic [[Supreme Chancellor]] Sheev Palpatine, gave [[Order 66]], a clone protocol meant for the immediate execution of all Jedi. [[File:GreeAndJekAreDead-CGSWG.png|thumb|right|250px|Clone Commander Gree and Clone Captain Jek lay dead after their unsuccessful assassination attempt.]] Sensing a [[Disturbance in the Force|disturbance]] during [[Anakin Skywalker]]'s fall to the [[dark side of the Force]] shortly prior, and a larger one as the [[Great Jedi Purge]] began, Commander Gree received the order via a [[hologram]] of Darth Sidious away from the others, confirming that the order would be done. When Commander Gree moved towards Yoda, he looked at Captain Jek and both nodded and immediately readied their [[blaster]]s to [[assassin]]ate Yoda, whom Jek had protected [[Standard year|years]] prior on Rugosa. Yoda, however, had [[Disturbance in the Force|sensed the ripples in the Force]] caused by so many Jedi murders all at once and anticipated what the two clones would do. Before the two could shoot him, Yoda suddenly leapt up and decapitated both of them with a single sweep of [[Yoda's lightsaber|his lightsaber]]. After both of their bodies collapsed, Tarfful and Chewbacca escaped with Yoda, through the [[jungle]] as the Separatists gained the upper hand in the battle due to the chaos following the execution of Order 66. Surviving clone forces rallied under Commander [[Faie]], and the Republic won the battle. Clone units unsuccessfully hunted down Yoda and subjugated their Wookiee allies. ==Personality and traits== {{Quote|Jek. Concerned about weapons you are. Weapons do not win battles. Your mind, powerful it is! Mmm? Outthink the droids you can.|Yoda, to Jek during their mission, to Rugosa|audio=YodaJek.flac|}} [[File:Jek-CTRaF.png|thumb|left|200px|Jek wearing his Phase I Coruscant Guard armor carrying a Z-6 rotary cannon and RPS-6 launcher.]] According to Master Yoda, Jek had an obsession with weapons, always thinking the strength of his team depended on having superior firepower. This mentality was reflected on [[Jek's rotary blaster cannon|his weapon of choice]], the [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon|rotary blaster cannon]], though Yoda encouraged him to think of his mind as a tool more powerful than any weapon. In the aftermath of their mission on Rugosa, Jek painted battle-droid heads on his weapon. ==Skills and abilities== As a clone trooper of the Grand Army of the Republic, Jek was skilled in armed and unarmed combat, heavy weaponry, and military tactics. Jek eventually retrained as a [[scout]] and was additionally skilled in reconnaissance and tracking. Jek also served as a [[clone trooper officer]], and was able to assist his superiors in observing a battle. ==Equipment== During his time in the Coruscant Guard, Jek made use of white [[Phase I clone trooper armor]] with [[Color|red]] markings and symbols denoting his unit affiliation, although his and those of his comrades were different from the standard markings of other Coruscant Guard.{{TCW|Hostage Crisis}} Jek customized his armor further with two hip [[holster]]s for a [[DC-17 repeater hand blaster|DC-17 hand blaster]] and a black [[bandolier]]. He relied on his [[Z-6 rotary blaster cannon]] during this time, as well as an [[RPS-6 rocket launcher]]. After transferring to the Ranger Corps, Jek equipped himself with [[Phase II ARF armor]] in green forest camouflage. On Kashyyyk, he used this armor with a [[DC-15A blaster carbine]]. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Jek is wearing mottled armor and listening to his comlink. He reacts with disbelief and regret, but must obey.|Jason Fry, on Jek receiving Order 66|{{Twitter|jasoncfry|1305897740891762688|[[Jason Fry]]|quote=That last scene we know from ROTS -- Thire's one of the shocktroopers searching for Yoda. The other two glimpses are new. Rys is dead. Jek is wearing mottled armor and listening to his comlink. He reacts with disbelief and regret, but must obey. ...|archiveurl=https://archive.is/7ObHK}}}} Jek first appeared in "[[Ambush]]," the first episode of the [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'', which premiered on [[Cartoon Network]] on [[October 3]], [[2008]].{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode001.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Ambush}} He was [[Retroactive continuity|retconned]] into being the clone trooper killed alongside Gree on Kashyyyk in the [[2005]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']] by author [[Jason Fry]], who first hinted at the retcon in his [[2020]] short story "[[Sharing the Same Face]]," an adaptation of "Ambush" published in the anthology ''[[The Clone Wars: Stories of Light and Dark]]'', before confirming it in the [[2021]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: Battles that Changed the Galaxy]]'', which Fry
